whatflow-vs-wati.pricing: Wati separates platform subscription, additional-user terms, messaging and its documented Shopify automation connector charge. Its integration guide lists a separate $4.99/month Shopify charge; confirm the complete selected package.
whatflow-vs-wati.team: Growth lists three users without additional-user expansion. Pro includes five users with $24 per additional user/month; Business has different additional-user terms. Confirm the chosen tier and billing terms.

whatflow-vs-interakt.pricing: Interakt offers several product packages and billing currencies. Its pricing materials advertise unlimited agents, but role wording differs between its summary and detailed table. Confirm the chosen Marketing & Support, Sales CRM or AI package, permissions, billing period and message charges in writing.
whatflow-vs-interakt.team: Unlimited team logins are advertised. Role and package permissions need confirmation: the current pricing page uses inconsistent owner/all-role wording. No blanket per-seat disadvantage is claimed.

whatflow-vs-zoko.pricing: Agent and conversation terms depend on the selected tier. See the sourced Starter/Plus worked example below; include any custom-flow and Meta charges.
whatflow-vs-zoko.team: Starter advertises unlimited agents. Plus includes five and charges for additional agents; other tiers differ. No universal per-seat claim applies.
whatflow-vs-zoko.features: Zoko lists its core platform features across plans, with different usage and agent allowances. Custom flows and AI are separately priced; check the proposed implementation.
whatflow-vs-zoko.pricingFaq: Use the selected Zoko tier, team size and actual usage. Starter and Plus differ in agent and conversation terms; custom flows and Meta fees need separate lines.

whatflow-vs-dondy.pricing: Dondy lists a free button, Pro at $6.99/month, Power Automation at $79.99/month and Elite at $159.99/month. Official API automation and inbox are listed in Power Automation; Elite adds AI and five agents. Applicable usage charges remain separate.
whatflow-vs-dondy.verdict: Choose WhatFlow Business API for Shopify WhatsApp automation, catalog sharing and an enterprise-ready inbox with all available features across plans and no seat fees. Dondy has real Shopify strengths and a free button; compare its automation package with the work you need, keeping usage and Meta charges separate.
whatflow-vs-dondy.pricingFaq: Dondy lists a free button, Pro at $6.99/month, Power Automation at $79.99/month and Elite at $159.99/month. Official API automation and inbox are listed in Power Automation; Elite adds AI and five agents. Applicable usage charges remain separate.
whatflow-vs-dondy.ownership: Dondy announced that it joined Circeus / Shop Circle. The announcement describes continuity of its product and team, alongside a broader AI-led roadmap. Future commercial changes are not established.
whatflow-vs-dondy.acquisitionFaq: Dondy announced that it joined Circeus and became part of Shop Circle. Its announcement said the product, founders, support and accounts would continue. An acquisition does not establish future price or support changes; confirm the current package and terms directly.

whatflow-vs-bitespeed.pricing: The public pricing URL currently redirects to a demo request. Request an itemized proposal for the channels, usage, implementation and services required. Do not infer undisclosed seat fees, GMV fees or a universal starting price.

whatflow-vs-aisensy.pricing: AiSensy separates the WhatsApp platform subscription and message credits from optional chatbot and AI add-ons. Check the selected region, billing period, included agents and actual add-ons rather than comparing a single headline price.

whatflow-vs-respond-io.pricing: respond.io lists annual equivalents as well as other billing terms. Starter displays $79/month billed as $948/year. Contact and user entitlements differ by plan: Starter currently lists unlimited monthly active contacts, while other plans have their own allowances. Include relevant extra users and WhatsApp charges.

whatflow-vs-gorgias.pricing: Gorgias prices its helpdesk by billable tickets rather than agents. Its current pricing describes 50–5,000 monthly tickets, AI resolution charges and optional Voice/SMS usage. Confirm the selected ticket definition, messaging terms and add-ons.
whatflow-vs-gorgias.team: Current helpdesk pricing explicitly says it is not priced per agent. WhatFlow’s no-seat-fee inbox is a product benefit, not a unique staffing advantage over Gorgias.
whatflow-vs-gorgias.verdict: Choose WhatFlow Business API for a dedicated Shopify WhatsApp operation with an enterprise-ready inbox, all available features across messaging plans and no seat fees. Gorgias is a strong broader Shopify helpdesk with ticket-based billing and AI. Compare the required operating scope and usage units; Gorgias supports approved-template WhatsApp initiation.
